theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: The only eligible theme with a complete staying-power signature: trend-gate passed (eligible), highest durability_bar among leaders (0.83), full breadth (1.0), and the headline val_state 'confirming'. Crowding (z=1.42) is a size-down caution, not a reason to fade per guardrails. Health Care EW (XLV, durability 0.8, breadth 0.95) corroborates the sector-level trend. Given track_record dir_accuracy is 0.413 — barely above coin-flip — I default low conviction and lean direction only, not size.
evidence: headline val_state 'confirming' and crowded=true as reflexivity caution
corroborated by Health Care EW (rank 3, durability 0.8, breadth 0.95, eligible)
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.42 means the trade is consensus — a sudden policy/pricing shock to pharma (e.g. drug-pricing headline) hits the most-owned theme hardest, and momentum rank itself has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: PPH underperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Same healthcare dispersion as Big Pharma but via a broader, equal-weight basket (XLV): durability_bar 0.80, breadth 0.95, eligible, trend-tagged. Lower single-name concentration than PPH, arguably cleaner for the trend-gate discipline. Crowding_z 1.52 is elevated but again only implies down-sizing. Corroborates the prevailing healthcare narrative rather than offering independent alpha.
evidence: same sector family as the headline Big Pharma theme
theses.dissent: Both PPH and XLV lean on the same macro healthcare narrative — this is not diversification, it is the same call twice; if the pharma theme rolls over, both fail together.

falsifier.text: XLV underperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The rank-1 leader is a trap for trend-following purposes: it fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false), durability_bar is a thin 0.34, and breadth is 0.0 — a completely narrow one-name move, not a theme. The guardrail says do NOT fade the dominant theme, and avoid is not a fade — it is declining to lean on a trend that has not matured into a trend. Proxy SMH is shared by several AI/semi themes that are also ineligible and negative-scored, so the ETF would not isolate this move anyway.
evidence: eligible=false — fails the only validated leg (absolute-trend gate)
rotation.leader id = memory_storage but directional=false in rotation block
theses.dissent: Momentum can persist well before breadth confirms; the gate is a risk-control, not a return predictor, and a single-name memory supplier squeeze could keep score elevated without a basket trend.

falsifier.text: SMH closes above its 20-day high with breadth above 0.5 before the check-by date
